item_name: Rothco Embroidered Don't Tread On Me Flag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Embroidered Don’t Tread On Me Flag showcases the timeless Gadsden design, a symbol of freedom and independence from the American Revolution. This high-quality flag is crafted from durable polyester material to withstand outdoor elements, ensuring it maintains its bold colors and iconic imagery over time. The flag features an intricately embroidered Gadsden Snake and the bold “Don’t Tread On Me” text, providing a striking visual.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Embroidered Don’t Tread On Me Flag showcases the timeless Gadsden design, a symbol of freedom and independence from the American Revolution. This high-quality flag is crafted from durable polyester material to withstand outdoor elements, ensuring it maintains its bold colors and iconic imagery over time. The flag features an intricately embroidered Gadsden Snake and the bold “Don’t Tread On Me” text, providing a striking visual. Available in 2 sizes, 3 feet x 5 feet and 5 feet x 8 feet, it’s perfect for mounting on flagpoles, displaying at events, or adding a patriotic touch to your home. Equipped with 2 sturdy metal grommets, the flag is easy to hang and is built for lasting durability, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to proudly showcase this historic symbol.
